name: Gin
workers: One process; the Go scheduler runs goroutines on GOMAXPROCS threads, which defaults to the 2 available CPUs
database_layer: GORM 1.31 with gorm.io/driver/postgres 1.6 (pgx 5), one database/sql pool of DB_POOL_SIZE connections
logging: none (gin.New() without the Logger middleware, GORM logger silent)
